short_description: Barrel Roll is a roguelike deckbuilder, turn based, taking place in a futuristic far west. The deck ? A 6 slot revolver barrel. Gather bullets with special effects, customize your revolver's barrel to create strong synergies and take down as much criminals as you can.
steam_categories: Single-player; Custom Volume Controls; Adjustable Difficulty; Mouse Only Option; Stereo Sound; Family Sharing
